Tooltip: Process of selects the specified user office and role in the confins system. The activity fails when the specified role or office is unavailable or the expected post-selection state cannot be confirmed.

Arguments.Name: Office
Arguments.Tooltip: Office to select in new confins. CAUTION the text is case sensitive.

Arguments.Name: Role
Arguments.Tooltip: Role to select in new confins. CAUTION the text is case sensitive.

Arguments.Name: TimeoutSelectRole
Arguments.Tooltip: The number in seconds of check select role before thrown an exception. The default value is 30 seconds.

Arguments.Name: MaxRetrySelectRole
Arguments.Tooltip: Maximum number of retries process select role in new confins. The default value is 3.

Arguments.Name: IntervalRetrySelectRole
Arguments.Tooltip: Interval in seconds to retries process select role in new confins. The default value is 5 seconds.
